label: Waiting for Descartes’s taxonomy of actual thinking
summary: In the unpinned Adam–Tannery Meditation II, Descartes lists doubting under thinking and identifies his own current doubt as inseparable from his thought. The passage starts from that performance. The analyst target ranges over every performed act of doubting whether thought occurs and requires an occurrence and realization witness.
